notes.title: Achievements, Part ONE
notes.content: [h2]Contract Modifier Achievements[/h2][p]These first eight achievements are based on (successfully) completing contracts with each modifier, as well as getting five stars on any contract.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479235/0ce39a83106065bf4ff7c0b3f1d8f79d29de0156.png"][/img][/p][h2]Retro-Active[/h2][p]If you have a saved game with contracts already complete, load into the home map and you will receive these achievements retro-actively.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Build Update 0.1.0
notes.content:
[h2]Health[/h2]
The [b]Soulglass[/b] now has health bar. It is tied to the same game mechanics as metrics (balance and flow), but is more of an active reflection of your performance so far. If health reaches zero, the contract instantly fails and you receive a [b]STRIKE[/b] on your contract timeline. The health bar take damage when:
[list]
[*] The Soulglass becomes completely unbalanced.
[*] If sand flow slows down beyond one of the metric thresholds (eg: [b]400[/b] to [b]300[/b] grains per minute).
[/list]
Catching Lifts will heal the health bar by a small percentage

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479235/787bfc94c7282ce4ab6ae371b94db06b19e00f84.png[/img]

[h2]Game Over[/h2]
Each failed contract (two Stars, forfeited, or health reaching zero) now counts towards a total count of [b]STRIKES[/b]. Once you reach three [b]STRIKES[/b], the game is over and you must begin again with a new set of abilities.

[h2]HUD Updates[/h2]
Tooltips added for meters, health bar added next to progress, and some colors adjusted for clarity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479235/4ad6ae43a5ae5c0cc489afa47de693a84d50aa38.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo Build Update 0.0.4
notes.content:
[h2]Controller Support[/h2]
General gameplay, input mapping, and menu navigation all work with controller input.
Controller support will receive another pass in the next week to improve usability and include interaction with tutorial pop-ups.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Floors no longer ignored with upward velocity.
[*] [b]Ricochet [/b]properly emits successful attack.
[*] Ability Visual Effects should now all destroy/reset properly when transition between maps.
[*] [b]Weight [/b] creation no longer collides with hourglass and instead attaches peacefully.
[*] Character Creation now fully resets all game state and character data.
[*] Hourglass will no longer load into broken state after a crash / game closed improperly.
[/list]

[h2]New Abilities / Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Teleport 2[/b] and [b]Teleport Range 2[/b] added.
[*] [b]Weight 2[/b] and [b]Weight 3[/b] added.
[*] [b]Dash[/b] duration buffed from [b]0.25s[/b] to [b]0.5s[/b].
[*] [b]Power Jump[/b] charge time increased from [b]1s[/b] to [b]1.2s[/b], but power increased from [b]3500[/b] to [b]4000[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479235/9f2f024d42dd3e84d9a9a01ec20b6a69c79e6bb0.png[/img]

[h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
[*] End of contract now fades in completion window.
[*] Ability List sorting updated: Type > Action Type > Name.
[/list]
